candidate.runtime: local authenticated FastAPI TestClient + SQLite; no browser/LLM/provider

foreign_scope_effect.before: Creator/audit authorship was the only writer gate; a canvas moved to another workspace/tenant could be saved or restored, appending an audit and replacing the mirror before the oracle refuted scope.
foreign_scope_effect.after: canvas_write_scope_error resolves the principal tenant/workspace against the authoritative Canvas row and restore target. The service preflights before dispatch; the writer rechecks inside the mutation transaction with a row lock where supported. Foreign scope returns 403 (404 for missing/foreign ownership) with unchanged audit/mirror and no broadcast or learning capture. New audit rows use the authoritative Canvas tenant. Post-effect scope refutation remains as defense in depth.

scope_policy.unscoped_canvas: available to an authorized same-tenant editor
scope_policy.null_principal_scope: legacy default only for an unscoped/default canvas
scope_policy.same_scope_coediting: preserved via creator or authoring audit history

old_identical_audit.before: A manual save without an operation_id had no server-owned request identity; a controlled CRUD result could return a prior update audit with identical content and still report verified.
old_identical_audit.after: Every direct update gets a fresh http-canvas-update:<uuid> identity when the caller omits one. Supplied operation ids remain idempotent retries bound to exact canonical material and accepted review state; different material is 409 before effect. Restores get a fresh http-canvas-restore:<uuid> identity written to the new audit. The verifier requires the returned audit to be the current content revision, so an old identical audit cannot certify a new save. No-change restores do not invent an audit/operation receipt.

no_change_stale_mirror.before: The no-change verifier compared target and latest audit content but not the durable Canvas.content mirror; a stale mirror could be reported verified.
no_change_stale_mirror.after: The no-change branch checks target action/content/tenant, current content revision, authoritative canvas mirror digest and scope. A stale mirror is no_change_unverified/refuted with effect none and replay=do_not_repeat, no audit, and no silent state change.
